title: In-product feedback – Weekly AI digest
description: Every Monday, summarizes last week's feedback with generative AI and posts the digest to Slack. Set the Slack connection and channel ID after import.

fetch_feedback.name: fetch_feedback
fetch_feedback.description: Fetch last week's feedback from Grail

input.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 7d
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd appName = coalesce(appName, "Unknown")
| fields timestamp, appName, appVersion, feedbackType, thumbs, feedback, device.type, geo.country.name
| sort timestamp asc
| limit 500

summarize.name: summarize
summarize.description: Summarize the feedback with generative AI

input.message:
:bar_chart: *Weekly in-product feedback digest*: {{ result('fetch_feedback').records | length }} entries in the last 7 days

{{ result('summarize').text }}
